notes.title: 《SunbreakWar》demo v1.15 Bug fix
notes.notes:
Fixed: After selecting the upgrade option for the main city in the first level, the issue where insufficient gold was available when constructing barracks and defense towers on the fourth day.

Fixed: The issue where the guidance circle indicating the archer's guard position was missing in the first level.

Fixed: Mission completion check issue in the first level.

Fixed: Issue where upgrading would halt attacks during skill activation.

Fixed: Certain UI adaptation issues.
